description: The authoritative free information layer on the EU battery passport mandatory from 18 February 2027.
tagline: Regulatory accuracy for battery and EV compliance.
image_alt: Battery Digital Passport — EU battery passport readiness and compliance information.

authors.name: Editorial Team
authors.bio: Our team of regulatory analysts tracks EUR-Lex and official EU sources to provide accurate, verified information on battery passport compliance.

editorial.testing: All obligations, data fields and dates are cited directly from official sources such as EUR-Lex. Anything not yet verified is strictly labelled as unverified.
editorial.revenue: This site is funded through vendor sponsorships and a paid readiness toolkit. We do not sell compliance software.
editorial.corrections: Corrections to regulatory data are made immediately upon verification from official EU bodies. Pages carry a last-verified date.
